text: `make test` runs go test -race ./... . Kafka and Postgres tests carry the `integration` tag and use testcontainers: `make test-integration` (needs Docker).
Consumers commit offsets only after the handler succeeds or the message is written to the DLQ. Never commit before handling.
Handlers must be idempotent: shipment events are redelivered after a rebalance. Dedupe on event_id using the processed_events table.
Wrap permanent failures with events.Permanent(err) so the consumer skips retries and sends the message straight to the DLQ.
The DLQ topic is shipments.dlq. Replay it with `parcelroute dlq replay --since 1h`; steps are in docs/runbooks/dlq-replay.md.
Config is env-only, parsed in internal/config/config.go with envconfig. Every new variable must also go into deploy/helm/values.yaml or prod won't get it.
Metrics use the parcelroute_ namespace and are registered in internal/metrics. Keep label cardinality bounded: never use event IDs as labels.
The Kafka client is sarama; consumer groups are set up in internal/events/sarama.go.
The Kafka client is franz-go (kgo). sarama was removed in March 2026; don't reintroduce it.
Rate quotes come from carrier adapters in internal/carriers/<name>/; each adapter has its own timeout in carriers.yaml.
Label PDFs are generated by the carrier and kept in the labels bucket for 90 days; we never render labels ourselves.
HTTP handlers are chi routes in internal/api/. api/openapi.yaml is the source of truth; regenerate with `make oapi`.
Wrap errors with fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err) and log once at the boundary; never log and return.
`make lint` runs golangci-lint with the repo config. Don't run a globally installed version; the rules differ.
Retries are left to Kafka: on error the consumer crashes and the pod restarts.
Address validation calls an external geocoding API with a 1,000/day quota in staging; mock it in tests.
PRs need one approval from shipping-core and are squash-merged with the PRC- ticket ID in the title.
Local stack: `docker compose up -d` starts Postgres and Redpanda (Kafka API on :19092); run the service with `make run`.
Migrations are goose files in migrations/. They run at startup in dev and through a Helm hook in prod.
Carrier sandbox accounts allow 100 label requests a day; label tests must use the recorded fixtures in testdata/carriers/.
Carriers return quote amounts in cents; we show them in the account's currency without conversion.
Prod runs 3 replicas. The consumer group is parcelroute-shipments on a 12-partition topic, so a slow retry blocks only its partition.
There is no DLQ: failed messages are logged and skipped.
